annotations.text: Motion: the video fades up over a pre-blurred still; tagline lines rise from a mask (1.1 s, stagger 0.085, ease fable); the pill arrives 1.05 s later; the scroll cue last. Chrome appears only after the intro.

Transitions: every internal link runs a WebGL displacement (dissolve / ripple / stretch) from the current hero to the destination hero, the route swaps underneath at the midpoint, and the curtain lifts onto this exact image. Zero reloads.

Drawer: backdrop blur 24 px, panel slides from the right (0.9 s, ease cinematic), blocks rise with a 0.06 s stagger, the padlock snaps shut, wallet buttons rise last. One tap on Apple Pay / Google Pay holds the seat.
